REPORT DATE: 09-21-2026 REPORT TIME: 2320 UTC REGION: GULF OF AMERICA SUB REGION: N/A AREA/BLOCK: EUGENE ISLAND 316 IMAGE DATE: 09-21-2026 IMAGE TIME: 1640 UTC DATA SOURCE: SENTINEL2C MODE: MULTISPECTRAL RESOLUTION: 10 METER LOCATION: 28°15'46" N/91°37'06" W AREA: 3.37 SQUARE KILOMETERS CONFIDENCE: MEDIUM-HIGH REPORT MAP/GIS FILES: HTTPS://WWW.OSPO.NOAA.GOV/PRODUCTS/OCEAN/MARINEPOLLUTION/ REMARKS: POSSIBLE OIL WAS OBSERVED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY. THIS ANOMALY IS UNCONFIRMED AS OIL. THE ANOMALY WAS BELIEVED TO BE ASSOCIATED WITH NOAA RESPONSE LINK HOTLINE #11216. IT WAS DISTINCT FROM VEGETATION AND SURROUNDING NATURALLY OCCURRING OCEAN PHENOMENA, EXHIBITING A SHARP CONTRAST AGAINST THE OCEAN SURFACE. THE ANOMALY MEASURED APPROXIMATELY 11.37 NM IN LENGTH AND 0.40 NM AT ITS WIDEST POINT. AT THE TIME OF THE IMAGE, WINDS WERE FROM THE E AT APPROXIMATELY 10 KTS. UNCERTAINTIES: THERE WAS SOME UNCERTAINTY REGARDING THE SOURCE OF THE ANOMALY. HOWEVER, THE ANOMALY WAS LOCATED APPROXIMATELY 4.45 NM ENE OF NOAA RESPONSE LINK HOTLINE #11216, WHICH HAD BEEN REPORTED MULTIPLE TIMES, MOST RECENTLY ON 9/20; THEREFORE, AN ASSOCIATION WAS MADE. ADDITIONALLY, SIGNIFICANT CLOUD COVER AND CLOUD SHADOW OBSCURED PORTIONS OF THE ANOMALY, MAKING IT DIFFICULT TO DETERMINE ITS FULL EXTENT. Report Description
///WEB REPORT/// ON DECEMBER 19, 2013 AT NW/4 SEC. 13 T31N R19W NMPM: 108D48'00"W, 36D54'18"N AT APPROXIMATELY 1630HOURS THE SUSPECTED RESPONSIBLE PARTY WAS IN PROCESS OF REMOVING ABANDON 16-INCH PIPE IN PROJECT AREA. WELDER PERFORMED A COLD CUT ON THE LINE AND SLOWLY DRAINED CRUDE OIL INTO DRAIN PAN WITH VACUUM TRUCK SUCKING OIL IN DRAIN PAN. AS PERSONNEL SLOPED THE BELL HOLE AND TUGGED ON PIPE TO LOOSEN, THE CRUDE OIL SUDDENLY SPILLED ONTO THE GROUND. APPROXIMATELY 1-2 BARRELS OF CRUDE OIL WERE RELEASED ONTO THE GROUND CREATING A CONTAMINATED AREA CONTAINED IN A DRAINAGE DITCH. THE AREA MEASURES 6 FEET DOWNSTREAM AND 4 FEET UPSTREAM FROM LOCATION. THE CRUDE OIL WAS IMMEDIATELY VACUUMED AND APPROXIMATELY 2 BARRELS RECOVERED. THE REMAINING CONTENTS WERE SPILLED AND MIXED WITH DIRT.
